newsitem.title: USA: LPC-MotivePower gets $75 mln BankAmerica loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-MotivePower gets $75 mln BankAmerica loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 15 (LPC) - BankAmerica Corp will syndicate a fully underwritten, $75 million senior secured loan for MotivePower Industries Inc, market sources said.
The sell-down will begin January 29, banking sources said.
The four-year deal is split between a $55 million revolver and a $20 million amortizing term loan, they said.
Pricing starts at 100 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), with a 30 basis-point commitment fee, sources said.
The pricing grid is tied to the company's debt burden.

Advances on the revolving credit are tied to a borrowing base. Financial covenants include fixed charge coverage, tangible net worth, limits on capital expenditures and operating leases, sources said.
